description: This file contains unit tests for the LDAPDao class within the OrangeHRM project. It verifies methods related to LDAP user retrieval, employee search, LDAP authentication providers, and LDAP synchronization status handling.

classes.name: LDAPDaoTest
classes.description: This class contains unit tests for various methods of the LDAPDao class, including user retrieval, employee lookup, LDAP provider management, and sync status updates.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the test environment by loading fixture data for LDAP DAO tests.

methods.name: testGetEmpNumbersHaveManyUsers
methods.description: Tests retrieval of employee numbers associated with multiple users.

methods.name: testGetNonLocalUserByUserName
methods.description: Verifies retrieval of non-local users based on username, including cases for non-existing, deleted, disabled, local, and LDAP users.

methods.name: testGetUserByUsername
methods.description: Tests user retrieval by username, covering non-existing, deleted, disabled, local, LDAP, and combined auth users with detailed assertions.

methods.name: testGetEmployee
methods.description: Tests retrieval of employee data based on various search filter parameters, ensuring correct employee data is returned and handling of non-unique results.

methods.name: testGetAuthProviderByUserUniqueId
methods.description: Verifies fetching of LDAP auth providers by user unique ID, including null case for nonexistent IDs.

methods.name: testGetAllLDAPAuthProviders
methods.description: Checks retrieval of all LDAP authentication providers and validates their attributes.

methods.name: testSaveLdapSyncStatus
methods.description: Tests saving LDAP synchronization status and verifies assigned properties and relationships.

methods.name: testGetLastLdapSyncStatus
methods.description: Verifies retrieval of the last LDAP sync status entry, including properties and associated user.
